name: kitewell
description: Kitewell monorepo — frontend, backend, and Soroban contracts for Stellar Testnet

scripts.dev: node init && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:all: node init && npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:frontend: node init && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start:backend: node init && npm run start -w backend
scripts.build:contracts: node init && stellar contract build --manifest-path contracts/kitewell/Cargo.toml
